intro: Hardware, software and the verbs of the screen, with the problems everyone knows.
b1.texto:
**The machine.** **El ordenador** (in Spain; **la computadora** in America), **la pantalla**, **el teclado**, **el ratón**, **el disco duro**, **el altavoz**, **la impresora**, **el escáner**, **el cable**.

**What is inside.** **Un archivo** lives in **una carpeta** on **el escritorio** (the desktop). **Un programa** or **una aplicación**. The classics: **un procesador de textos**, **una hoja de cálculo**, **una base de datos**.

**What you do.** **Encender** and **apagar**. **Abrir**, **cerrar**, **guardar** un archivo. **Pinchar en** or **hacer clic en** un enlace; **hacer doble clic**. **Arrastrar** un archivo a una carpeta. **Copiar**, **cortar**, **pegar**. **Descargar** and **subir**. **Instalar** un programa. **Imprimir**.

**Settings.** **Configurar**, **cambiar la configuración**, **cambiar el tamaño de la letra**, **actualizar** el sistema.

**Accounts.** **El usuario** and **la contraseña**. **Iniciar sesión** and **cerrar sesión**.

**Disasters.** **El ordenador se ha bloqueado** or **se ha colgado**. **Ha entrado un virus.** **Se me ha borrado** el archivo. The cure: **reiniciar** and, next time, **hacer una copia de seguridad**.

**Online.** **El servidor**, **el proveedor**, **la red**, **la nube**, **una videoconferencia**.

**New words.** Spanish coins its own when it can: **la inteligencia artificial**, **el correo electrónico**, **la nube**. Others stay in English: **el software**, **el wifi**, **el router**.
b2.f0: Technical support, good morning. How can I help you?
b2.f1: My computer has frozen and I can't open any files.
b2.f2: Have you tried restarting it? Hold the button down until the screen goes off.
b2.f3: Done. Now it's asking me for a password I don't remember setting.
b2.f4: Click on the link 'I've forgotten my password' and you'll get an email. By the way, do you have a backup?
b2.f5: I'm afraid not. If I had known, I would have made one yesterday.
b4.o0.refuerzo: Pinchar en means to click on, so en follows the verb.
b5.pregunta: The computer does not respond. It…
b5.o2.refuerzo: That is it has been set up.
b6.pregunta: To move a file with the mouse, you…
b7.o0: My file has been deleted (by accident).
b7.o1: I have rubbed out the folder on purpose.
b7.o1.explicacion: Se me ha borrado: it happened to me. Archivo is a file.
b7.o2: The file has made me bored.
b8.pregunta: Complete: hold it until the screen goes off.
b8.o0.refuerzo: Hasta que, about the future, takes the subjunctive.
b8.o1.refuerzo: In an instruction about what is still to happen, the subjunctive.
b8.o2.refuerzo: After hasta que, never the future.
b9.pregunta: A copy of your files kept in case of disaster is…
b9.o0.refuerzo: Una copia de seguridad is a backup, a copy kept in case of disaster.
b10.traduccion: You have to update the system and restart the computer.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write instructions for a relative who is not good with computers: how to do a backup and what to do if the computer freezes.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Explain a computer problem aloud to a technician over the phone, and follow or give instructions.
b7.o0.explicacion: Se me ha borrado means it has been deleted, and se me suggests it was unintended.
